name: ocrmypdf
description:
OCRmyPDF adds an optical character recognition (OCR) text layer to scanned PDF files. It transforms image-only PDFs into searchable, selectable, and accessible documents that can be highlighted and indexed by desktop search engines.

Features:
- Embeds high-accuracy text layers using the Tesseract OCR engine
- Keeps original scanned page images intact without losing image quality
- Automatically deskews, cleans up, and corrects orientation of scanned pages
- Validates PDF/A compliance for long-term document archiving
- Batch processes multi-page documents utilizing multiple CPU cores
